answer_1.quote: We study learning from the feedback collected during deployment of models in human-model conversations... we deploy conversational models (bots) that are asked to exhibit these skills... Human conversationalists select a task... and then ask the model to help them complete it over a series of conversational turns.
datasets: Human-model conversation dataset with task annotations

answer_2.quote: We provide automatic evaluation results in Table ... we measure automatic evaluation metrics (F1 and PPL).

answer_3.quote: We employ a 311M parameter transformer pre-trained on pushshift.io Reddit ... we train it with a standard classification loss on our satisfaction task. One obvious approach is to rerank generation candidates from the conversational model using the reward model with the aim that the highest ranked provide the highest satisfaction.

answer_4.quote: For each conversation, we ask 3 human crowdworkers to rate the bot and human's performance and also assess if the bot was able to complete the given task... we also collect a final rating (out of 5) for the bot's performance.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters provide a final rating (1-5) of the bot, judge task completion, and mark whether each response was good or had issues.
